meta.description: Give your clients a co-branded estate vault they'll actually use. Everstead for advisers includes a client portal, readiness tracking, and document access, built for IFAs, solicitors, and wealth managers.
meta.ogTitle: Everstead for Advisers | Estate Organisation for Your Clients
meta.ogDescription: Give your clients a co-branded estate vault they'll actually use. Everstead for advisers includes a client portal, readiness tracking, and document access.

hero.title: Your clients need an organised estate. We help them build one.
hero.subtitle: Everstead gives advisers a co-branded client vault, with readiness tracking, document access, and a portal your clients open between every meeting.

problem.title: Most clients come to meetings unprepared, and both of you know it.
problem.p1: They can't find the pension statement from 2019. They haven't updated their LPA since their divorce. Their digital accounts are scattered across six different email addresses, and their spouse doesn't know any of the passwords.
problem.p2: The result: the first hour of every review is spent on administration, not advice. And when the worst happens, the executor spends months chasing information that should have been organised years earlier.
ifaBullets: First meeting spent finding basic account information
Clients with no record of digital assets or subscriptions
Executors calling you after a death with basic questions
LPAs and wills that haven't been reviewed in years
No way to track client readiness across your book
solicitorBullets: Weeks spent chasing documents before probate can begin
Clients who die with no clear record of their assets
Families calling in distress without knowing what their loved one had
Wills and LPAs that can't be located when needed
No single source of truth before administration begins

benefits.title: Everything your practice needs. Nothing it doesn't.

items.title: Clients arrive better prepared
items.desc: When a client has an Everstead vault, your initial meetings go deeper. No more spending the first hour hunting for account numbers or discovering a missing LPA.

items.title: Co-branded client portal
items.desc: Your firm's name and branding appear inside the client's vault. Every time they log in, they see your relationship, not a third-party tool.

items.title: Track readiness across your book
items.desc: See which clients have completed their estate plan, who still has gaps, and where the biggest risks sit, across all your clients in one workspace.

items.title: Your liability, protected
items.desc: Everstead is an organisation and access tool, it does not give financial, legal, or tax advice. Its scope is clearly defined in its terms of service. Recommending it to clients does not create professional liability for your firm.

items.title: Document visibility on your terms
items.desc: Clients choose what to share with you. You can view uploaded documents, account registers, and instructions, only what they've explicitly granted you access to.

items.title: Compliant data handling
items.desc: UK data residency, AES-256 encryption, and full GDPR compliance. Your clients' data is held to the same standard you'd expect from any professional tool.

ongoing.title: Ongoing, not one-off
ongoing.desc: Estate organisation isn't a single meeting, it's ongoing. Everstead keeps clients engaged between reviews, with smart reminders that flag changes and gaps.

steps.title: Up and running in days, not months.

items.title: Apply for early access
items.desc: We're working directly with the first 50 advisory firms. Tell us a bit about your practice and we'll be in touch within 48 hours.

items.title: Onboard your team
items.desc: We set up your co-branded workspace, add your team members, and walk you through the adviser portal in under an hour.

items.title: Invite your clients
items.desc: Clients receive a branded invitation to set up their vault. Most complete their first session in under 30 minutes.

items.title: Manage from one place
items.desc: See every client's readiness score, access shared documents, and track progress, all in your adviser dashboard.

useCases.title: Built for professionals who deal with estates.

items.title: Independent financial advisers
items.desc: Add estate organisation to your service without building it yourself. Clients with organised estates make better decisions and trust you more.

items.title: Estate solicitors
items.desc: Reduce the back-and-forth before probate. When a client's vault is complete, your team has what they need without weeks of document-chasing.

items.title: Accountants & tax advisers
items.desc: Help clients track assets, subscriptions, and accounts in one place. A cleaner picture at year-end, and far fewer surprises.

items.title: Wealth managers
items.desc: Differentiate your offering by giving high-net-worth clients a tool their bank doesn't. The family vault positions you as genuinely comprehensive.

resources.title: Practical content, written for practitioners.
resources.body: No registration to read, just give us an email and we'll send it. We won't pass it on, and you can unsubscribe at any time.
resources.emailSubtitle: One email. No registration. Unsubscribe any time.

items.label: Conversations
items.title: The Adviser's Guide to Inheritance Conversations
items.summary: Seven framings IFAs and solicitors use to open the estate conversation with clients, without sounding morbid or salesy. Drawn from pilot practices.

items.label: Template
items.title: Pre-bereavement client checklist
items.summary: A working six-section template covering identity, financial inventory, documents, the family map, emotional preparation, and your firm-side process. Use as-is or adapt for your practice.

items.label: Playbook
items.title: Estate organisation as a value-add: pricing & positioning playbook

earlyAccess.title: We're onboarding our first adviser partners now.
earlyAccess.body: Everstead is in early access. We're working directly with a small cohort of IFAs, solicitors, and estate planners to shape how the adviser portal develops. If you work with clients on estate or later life planning, we'd like to hear from you.

plan.title: Join the first cohort of adviser partners.
plan.body: We're working personally with our first adviser firms, with a direct line to the founding team. You help shape the product. We handle everything else.

card.title: First 50 firms, onboarded personally
card.body: We're working directly with the first 50 advisory firms. You get a personal onboarding session, a direct line to the founding team, and the ability to shape how the adviser portal develops.

bottom.title: The adviser channel built around your practice.
bottom.body: Estate planning software built around advisers, not just individuals. Give your clients a vault they'll return to, and a tool that makes your practice more efficient.
